payload.text: The estate page (served by intentd, started 2026-11-01 06:18Z without CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR) sees no Claude sessions, so it labels every running slot ORPHANED; reproduced by running the census with the variable unset (0 sessions, every slot orphaned) against 24 with it set.
